# What's the Best Way to Manage Internal Requests From Every Department in One Queue?


The best way is to route every department's requests, IT, facilities, HR, finance, into the same Service Desk structure, categorized but centrally visible. On **Jestor** , this runs through **Service Desk** covering multiple request types.


Each department running its own separate request inbox, IT here, facilities there, HR somewhere else, means no one has a consolidated view of internal request volume across the whole company.


## What separate departmental inboxes cost


- No consolidated view of internal request volume across the entire company
- Employees confused about which inbox to use for a given type of request
- Difficulty comparing response time and workload across different departments
- Requests occasionally sent to the wrong inbox and delayed as a result


## How a unified internal request queue works


- Every department's requests route into the same **Service Desk** structure
- Requests categorize by type, IT, facilities, HR, finance, while staying centrally visible
- Employees have one place to submit any internal request, regardless of type
- Response time and workload become directly comparable across departments


## Why Jestor fits this use case


- Unified routing removes the confusion of multiple separate departmental inboxes
- One place to submit requests simplifies the experience for every employee
- Comparable workload data across departments supports better resource planning
- This scales from a small company to a large organization with many request types


Separate departmental inboxes Unified request queue


No consolidated visibility Centrally visible, categorized by type


## Frequently Asked Questions


**Do different departments see only their own category of requests?** Yes, permissions can filter each department's default view to their own requests. More at[jestor.com](https://www.jestor.com/?ref=blog.jestor.com) .


**Can employees see the status of their own submitted request?** Yes, typically through a personal dashboard view.


**Does this support SLA tracking per request category?** Yes, SLA can be tracked and compared across different categories.
